new_today_news.headline: Federal Register: Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) Program Standards for 2026 and 2027
new_today_news.summary: EPA publishes final RFS standards for 2026-2027, establishing renewable fuel volume obligations and carbon intensity requirements. Standards mandate increased biomass-based biofuel blending with emphasis on waste-derived feedstocks including FOG and UCO.
